page.overview:
What is Fort Slava?

Fort Slava is a fortress atop a high hill that is surrounded by two walls, the low outer wall armed with machine gun bunkers and the high inner wall armed with anti-Titan artillery units, a devastating weapon that can kill a Titan of any variety in one shot. Its position overlooking the harbor allows those within to spot enemies from a distance, preventing the possibility of a sneak attack. There are three interconnected railway tracks that encompass the fort between the walls, with switching tracks connecting the three railways to each other. There are eight bunkers evenly spaced in the lower inner wall, each one housing two machine guns. The tracks lead back within the fort in four entrances - North, East, South, and West. These tracks carry armored trains equipped with particularly deadly anti-Titan artillery cannons.

The outer wall mounts twenty turret structures, each holding a massive mortar overlooking the outside area of the fort. Two turrets surround each of the four gates for the armored trains to use, and there are three evenly spaced turrets between each railway gate, leading to a 360 degree field of view. These mortars can be supported by the armored train as well, with the railway network on the interior leading up to the walls themselves with two large ramps encircling much of the interior of the large wall. The interior of the fort consists of various tall buildings ranging from barracks, to supply and ammunition depots, medical facilities, mess halls, and more. The center of the fort holds a turntable for use by the armored train, surrounded by tracks leading to the gates, as well as sheds for train maintenance and repairs.

During the battle of Fort Slava at the climax of the Marley Mid-East War, the Warrior candidates dig trenches in the landscape all around the fortress beyond the outer wall, allowing for soldiers to attack the Allied defenses from a covered position. The battle significantly damages the fort, with the Titan airstrike devastating parts of the outer wall, as well as ruining many buildings inside.

In the year 854, the weakened Allied Forces make their final stand at Fort Slava, a key tactical position protecting the Allied flagship fleet, stationed within the nearby naval-station. Marleyan forces wanted to take the area, knowing that attacking the port would be impossible without control of the Fort. The fortress held an armored train with anti-Titan artillery equipped, however, meaning that Marley would not risk deploying its Warrior forces. Therefore, battle was at a stalemate, with the 800 man unit of Eldian ground forces attempting to dig trenches to better surround the Fort. However, this plan was halted when the front unit of the 800 Eldian unit was hit by explosives.
